messages:
maria: Heads-up — need a quick capacity check for an external benchmark this weekend (us-central1). Ticket TKT-4321. Requesting 4x A100 (40GB) for ~6 hours starting Sat 10:00 UTC. Can we get a soft reserve or vendor borrow? cc @devin @sasha

devin: What's the fallback if we can't get 4x A100? can we mix A100 + H100 or spin multiple smaller instances?

sasha: We should avoid spot for this one — SLA to customer. If vendor can't commit, we can do 2x A100 + 2x H100 as backup. Also need a rollback/cleanup window.

ops-bot: Quota check result for project redwood-prod: us-central1 A100 quota 2 available, H100 quota 0 available. Linked ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-4321

ashok: I can lend 2x A100 from demo-pool for the window. Need CI gate on the terraform change. also what's the exact machine type? a2-highgpu-1g (A100-40GB) or something else?

maria: machine_type: a2-highgpu-1g (A100-40GB). snippet to check quotas locally: ```gcloud compute regions describe us-central1 --project=redwood-prod | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'```

liam: I'll own the PR review/merge if you add the soft-reserve TTL and a cleanup script. ping me when ready. :thumbsup:

devin: Vendor (CloudVendorOps) pinged — tentative 48h ETA for extra quota but not guaranteed. I'll open fallback plan to carve 2x from dedicated pool + 2x demo borrow. Filing PR now.

maria: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/789 — includes temp tag `bench-weekend-2026` and cleanup job. @liam please review.

liam: Reviewing now. quick note: add `max_unavailable=1` to avoid blackout. also add a post-run alert to #incidents. otherwise good.

maria: added the change, CI green. merging in ~5m. thanks everyone. :rocket:

devin: Vendor confirmed soft hold on 2 A100s (until Sat 12:00 UTC). still waiting on the other two. will update if it converts to hard quota.

ashok: Borrow confirmed for 2 A100s from demo-pool, tagged accordingly. cleanup hook scheduled for Sat 17:00 UTC.

maria: Final check — anyone want the run window shifted earlier to reduce risk? if not, proceeding.

sasha: earlier is fine for us, but keep the current start. good luck.

maria: done. thread closed after run. I'll post postmortem in #postmortems if anything odd.
